groups.activity: Level 40-50 Ghoul bounties from Konzu; hunt Assassinate stages

rows.label: Quartakk Blueprint
rows.note: 50% from the Ghoul Auger Alpha; about 4.85% on stages 2 and 3 and 4.72% on the final stage, Rotation A

conditions: Only runs while Ghoul Purge is active; it ends when the Ghoul population is exterminated, and console and PC can end at different times.
Only the Auger Alpha carries the blueprint, and Auger or Rictus is random. Kill the 20 Ghouls in the marked area within 5 minutes or the stage fails.
The Level 15-25 bounty has no Quartakk blueprint.
bonuses: Stubba drops from the same Alpha at 50%.

disclosures.title: getting Assassinate stages
disclosures.body: Alphas only appear in Assassinate stages, which can show up at any stage of either tier. Leave and re-queue until the bounty contains one. Wisp motes or a flying companion get runs to about a minute each.

rows.label: Quartakk
rows.note: 75 Grokdrul, 15 Fersteel Alloy, 12,450 Salvage, 5 Neural Sensors

disclosures.title: buying it built
disclosures.body: The built Quartakk is also sold in the Market, individually or in the Maggor Assault Pack.
